verdict.rationale: Mistral's OCR can return, per page, a `blocks` array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, block labels and extracted content in reading order. Mistral also markets its structured output as 'citation-ready', so page, bbox and snippet provenance exist at the OCR block level. However, the structured-extraction feature (document_annotation) is documented only as an annotation of the whole document, with no per-field page, bbox or source-span linkage, and one community tester reported no text-level bounding boxes. missing for 10: per-extracted-field provenance linking annotation fields to page/bbox/snippet, word-level bounding boxes, hands-on corroboration of block provenance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify

citations.quote: When enabled, each page contains a blocks array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and extracted content in reading order.
Its structured output supplies citation-ready inputs to the toolkit's ingestion, retrieval, and evaluation workflow for RAG and enterprise search.
